bodies.selection_notes: G-like dwarf candidate selected using 5300-6000 K, model logg 4.2-4.65, mass 0.7-1.25 Msun, radius 0.7-1.5 Rsun, |z|<2 kpc, median Galactic radius >=12 kpc and the distance-posterior radial lower bound >=11.5 kpc. StarHorse output/age-consistency warnings are absent. Not a confirmed isolated star; models and spin remain uncertain, as stated in its description.

sources.reference: Queiroz et al. (2023), A&A 673, A155, corrected SDSS DR12 StarHorse catalog; 2023 erratum A&A 676, C6

derived_sensitivity_ranges.interpretation: Conservative corners of the published marginal 16th/84th percentiles; correlations are unavailable, so these are not joint credible intervals.

sources.method: Adopt StarHorse posterior medians for mass, temperature, gravity and distance. Derive R=sqrt(G*M/(10**logg*0.01)); derive L/Lsun=(R/Rsun)**2*(T/5772)**4. Round T to 1 K and R/L to 0.0001 solar units.
sources.note: These are estimates from spectroscopy, photometry, Gaia astrometry and single-star evolutionary models, not direct measurements of mass or radius. Published distance 5th/95th percentiles enclose 90% of the model posterior. Model errors and unknown companions are not covered by that statement; no 90% accuracy claim is made for the adopted point values.

sources.reference: Barnes (2007), ApJ 669, 1167, Equations 1-2
sources.method: P_days = a*(B-V-c)**b*(1000*age_gyr)**n; invert Ballesteros (2012) Equation 14 to estimate intrinsic B-V from effective temperature. Round the resulting period to 0.1 day.

input_sensitivity_range_days.inputs: StarHorse age 5th/95th and temperature 84th/16th percentiles; model coefficients held fixed.

sources.note: Unmeasured rotation: classical gyrochronology estimate for a slow-rotator single-star model. Color is inferred from temperature, not measured B-V. Old-star weakened magnetic braking, metallicity, differential rotation and any undetected companion can invalidate the age-spin relation. The sensitivity range is not a calibrated 90% prediction interval.

sources.reference: Gaia DR3 gaia_source; StarHorse model distance used separately
sources.method: Linearly propagate the ICRS unit-vector direction using tangent-plane proper motion from Gaia epoch J2016 to J2000, then normalize. No precession is needed within ICRS. Perspective acceleration is neglected. Distance = 1000*StarHorse Dist50 kpc, not inverse parallax.
sources.note: Parallaxes of these faint stars are noisy and can be negative; they are only checked for >3-sigma inconsistencies with the spectrophotometric distance, allowing a 0.03-mas systematic term. Proper-motion propagation changes the direction by tiny amounts compared with distance uncertainty.

sources.reference: Gaia DR3 source, NSS bit field and variability classifier; SIMBAD identifier lookup
sources.note: No known stellar companion in the checked records: NSS=0, RUWE<1.2, not duplicated, no multi-peak detections; no Gaia classified eclipsing binary or SIMBAD double/binary flag. A missing classifier/SIMBAD entry is absence of information, not proof of singleness. DSC star/binary probabilities are deliberately not used. system_type=single selects the approved in-game single-star model.
